theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.98%) and Health Care (+1.14%) led the market today, while Utilities (-2.53%) and Energy (-0.32%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.64%, defensives -0.25%, and value/cyclicals +0.53% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.43%, Dow +0.98%, Nasdaq +0.43% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.85%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 5.50% to 15.13, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.54% to $4,661.60, crude oil was little changed at $86.64, and bitcoin gained 6.38% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
